candidates.change_summary: Delete the require statement that checks `_tos.length > 0` so that the function does not revert on an empty array and returns true instead.

Replace `require(_s)` with `require(!_s)` so that the function reverts when the external call succeeds instead of when it fails, potentially completing with return value true only when all calls fail.
Replace `return true` with `return false` so that the function returns false on success instead of true.
Insert `return false;` as the first statement in the function body, causing the function to return early without executing any external calls.
Replace the requirement that _tos.length > 0 with a requirement that _tos.length > 0 is false, making the function revert whenever the original would proceed.
Change the transferFrom selector hash string from the correct ERC20 transferFrom signature to a different method signature.
Change the loop increment from i++ to i += 2 so only every other element of _tos is processed.
Change the loop condition from i < _tos.length to i <= _tos.length, causing an out-of-bounds access when the loop reaches the final index.
Initialize the loop counter at 1 instead of 0 so the first element of _tos is skipped.
Swap the call arguments so caddress is passed as the token recipient and _tos[i] is used as the target contract address.
Use the loop index i instead of _tos[i] as the transfer recipient in the external call.
Ignore the success flag returned by the external call and require it to be false, reverting exactly when the call succeeds.
Return false instead of true on successful completion of all transferFrom calls.
Replace the initial transfer-value flag requirement with a tautological requirement, allowing calls to proceed even when the loop has no iterations after the initial length check.
Replace the transferFrom selector hash with a different selector, causing the external call to route to a different function and return different success values.
Initialize the loop counter to 1 instead of 0, skipping the first destination in the transfer loop.
Change the loop condition to compare the counter against the destination array length offset by one, altering which destinations are processed.
Increment the loop counter by two instead of one, causing every other destination to be skipped.
Pass the sender-of-this-call (msg.sender) to the external transferFrom call instead of the provided from parameter.
Pass the current destination as the source argument to the external transferFrom call instead of the provided from parameter.
Return false instead of true after all external transfers succeed, changing the function's reported result.
Replace the require on line 6 with require(_tos.length == 0), making the function revert exactly when the original would not and vice versa.
Delete the require on line 6, so the function no longer reverts on an empty _tos array.
Change the loop condition from i<_tos.length to i>_tos.length, so the body never executes and the function returns true without any external calls.
Change the external call selector from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,address,uint256), so calls to caddress invoke a different function and likely revert.
Replace require(_s) with require(!_s), so the function reverts exactly when the external call succeeds.
Change the return value from true to false, so the observable return value of the function is reversed.
